effects.description: Gives the recipient a HP Shield. All damage the recipient takes will be subtracted from the Shield first, before their HP.Each Skill can only cast one Shield at a time on each recipient.

bio: The Freeborn fear nothing save for the sea they claim to protect – or, rather, what lies beneath it. The beasts in the depths strike fear into even the hardiest pirates, so the Freeborn sought an answer: Quelron, a monster that can face the dark ocean, and can triumph.
